newsitem.title: GERMANY: BoE's George-no real improvement in EMU prospects.
newsitem.headline: BoE's George-no real improvement in EMU prospects.

text.p: Bank of England Governor Eddie George said on Tuesday he had noted no recent improvements in prospects for nations meeting the convergence criteria to join Europe's planned currency union.
Asked whether he thought that prospects for EMU were improving, he replied: "That would be too strong to say."
George, who was speaking to reporters after a regular monthly meeting at the European Monetary Institute (EMI), declined to comment on prospects for the chances of an imminent U.K. rate cut.

Some European financial leaders, including EMI president Alexandre Lamfalussy, have recently expressed optimism that nations were making progress in reaching the entry criteria for the currency union, scheduled to begin at the end of the decade.
